title: Walls And Gates
description:
In a floor plan, -1 is a wall, 0 is a gate, and 2147483647 is an unfilled room. For every unfilled room, write the fewest side-steps to any gate, leaving unreachable rooms unchanged. Return the completed grid.

Distances from all gates compete; a room keeps the smallest one.

Example 1:

Input: rooms = [[2147483647,-1,0],[2147483647,2147483647,2147483647]]
Output: [[4,-1,0],[3,2,1]]

The wall forces the upper-left room to take a four-step detour.

Example 2:

Input: rooms = [[2147483647]]
Output: [[2147483647]]

No gate is available.

Example 3:

Input: rooms = [[0,2147483647,0]]
Output: [[0,1,0]]

Either gate is one step from the middle.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= rows, columns <= 100; an empty grid has no islands.
  • All rows have equal length; cells have the values stated above.
  • Only side-sharing cells are adjacent; diagonal contact does not connect them.
  • Each entry is -1, 0, or 2147483647.
